notes.title: Update Oct 23 2018
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Game graphics has been improved.
I applied the graphics related functions that I could not apply due to the mobile build environment. The screen looks a little richer, and the addition work has been done so that the shot points are not covered by polygons.

[*] The timing of the damage is displayed.
Nearly all attacks, except projectiles, show the correct timing. You can now do some more evasive maneuvers intuitively.
[/list]


[h1][b]Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the physical movement of the gun when the player was knocked was strange.
[/list]

notes.title: CrownFall will be switched to free
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We're here to announce you that CrownFall will be switched to free on the following week. This decision was made at the request of the developer, EnchantedLands(LegendaryTaler), and we accepted it after a brief discussion with him. We expect this price change to be applied around October 25th.

We're sorry for those who have already purchased CrownFall, but we sincerely appreciate your interest in our game. Even after the game is free, your current progress won't be lost and the game will still be in your library.

If you're unhappy with this change, you can refund the game; but please note that you should meet Steam's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds/]refund policy[/url].

Please stay tuned for further updates. Thank you very much.

notes.title: Update Aug 23 2017
notes.content:
The bug has been fixed and features have been added!

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the number of retries occasionally overlaps and accumulates.
[/list]

[h1][b]New features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Now, the mouse cursor can not get out of the game window.
You can escape using the Alt + Tab.
[*]When defeated in combat, you can use the Retry function.
You can retry quickly without going to the lobby.
[/list]

[h1][b]Note[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]In the case of the re-game function during the game, even if you lose a lot of health early on, but sometimes you can succeed defeat the boss.
This feature may encourage quick give up, so we are still pending work.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Aug 21 2017
notes.content:
The bug has been fixed and features have been added!

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the language selection did not work well with the Xbox 360 pad in the Options window.
[*]Operational sensitivity to the Xbox 360 Pad has been improved.
[/list]

[h1][b]New features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Input tab added to option window.
Although not all options related to control settings exist, you can set the dodge direction when using the keyboard and mouse, or the Xbox 360's aiming method.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Aug 19 2017
notes.content:
The bug has been fixed and features have been added!

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the disappearance of saved games.
[*]Fixed the text truncation in game result window.
[/list]

[h1][b]New features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a structure that users can translate directly.
When you create a file that fits format, you can use that translation in the game.
See ReadMe.txt and Example.csv in the CrownFall_Extra folder.
[/list]
